🚧 Traffic Advisory 🚧

Miami-Dade Water and Sewer crews will conduct a proactive inspection of the sanitary sewer system near West Flagler Street and NW 12th Avenue from Tuesday, March 3 through Friday, March 6, beginning nightly at 8 p.m.

Intermittent lane closures will occur between 8 p.m. and 2 a.m.:
* West Flagler Street: Westbound reduced to one lane from NW 11th Avenue to NW 13th Avenue
* NW 12th Avenue: Northbound reduced to one lane from SW 1st Street to NW 1st Street; southbound reduced to one lane from NW 1st Street to SW 1st Street

Police will be on site directing traffic. All lanes will reopen after work hours each night. @MiamiDadeWater
